_instructions: Template for a client data file. Copy to clients/<name>/client-data.json and fill in. Delete the partner block for a single client. Ages drive the timeline: the projection runs from the current tax year until the OLDEST person reaches plan.endAge. All amounts are annual and in £ unless stated. growthRate null means 'use the matching global assumption'. IDs must be unique strings.

plan.title: Financial plan for the Example family

incomes.name: Salary — Employer Ltd
incomes._note: endAge null on employment = stops at that person's retirementAge. growthRate null = wage growth assumption.

expenditure.name: Essential spending
expenditure._note: Paste categorised totals from the bank-statement tool here as separate rows. growthRate null = inflation.

assets.name: Cash savings
assets._note: cash growth is treated as taxable interest (PSA applied). ISA growth is tax-free. GIA growth is taxed via dividends/CGT approximation. Pension contributions get tax relief.

assets.name: Workplace pension
assets._note: Contributions = pct of linked salary while it pays, plus any fixed annualContribution.

businesses._note: Optional: businesses the clients own. Each gets its own growth model on the 'Businesses owned' tab; the owned share of the valuation feeds net worth and IHT. Link the salary/dividend income entries drawn from it so a 'Sell the business' what-if stops them. valuationBasis 'multiple' values at profit × valuationMultiple; 'fixed' grows valuationToday at growthRate.

_example.name: Example Trading Ltd
_example._dividends_note: dividendsDrawn adds that much dividend income directly (today's £; tracks business growth unless dividendsGrowth is set). dividendSplit allocates it between people by percentage (shares are normalised, and re-normalise across survivors if someone dies); omit it to tax the owner (joint = even split). Use dividendIncomeId ONLY to tag an income entry that already exists in incomes[] — don't use both or the dividends double-count. Growth is overridable year-by-year in assumptions.yearOverrides[i].bizGrowth[bizId].

liabilities.name: Mortgage — family home
liabilities._note: Amortised annually: interest accrues, annualPayment reduces balance, payment appears in cash flow until repaid. offsetAssetIds (optional): cash asset ids offset against this mortgage — the offset slice earns no (taxable) interest and mortgage interest is charged only on the balance above it. Also settable live in the plan's Debts tab.

yearOverrides._note: Optional per-year overrides, keyed by year index from plan start ("0", "1", ...). Each entry may set inflation, wageGrowth, or growth:{assetId:rate}. Also editable live in the plan UI.

events._note: Saved what-if events (same shape the plan UI creates). Usually leave empty; build scenarios live with the client.
